import pathlib,subprocess,json,time,datetime,hashlib,itertools,sys
E=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rows=[]
def cmd(args,timeout=30,**kwargs):return subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=timeout,**kwargs)
def run(label,version,duration=10,diagnostic=None):
 name='wk-listener-'+label
 server=['docker','run','-d','--name',name,'--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--cpuset-cpus','4-7','--memory','3g','-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','-e','GOGC=100','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/'+version+'-probe','debian:12','-mode','server','-addr','127.0.0.1:7000','-read='+str(read).lower(),'-version',version,'-allocation-probe']
 if diagnostic:server+=['-pprof','127.0.0.1:6060']
 created=False;proc=None;row=None
 try:
  cmd(server);created=True;deadline=time.monotonic()+15
  while True:
   logs=cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout
   if b'RPC_PROBE_READY' in logs:break
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline,logs
   time.sleep(.2)
  client=['docker','run','--rm','--name',name+'-client','--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--network','container:'+name,'--cpuset-cpus','0-3','--memory','3g','-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','-e','GOGC=100','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/old-alloc-probe','debian:12','-mode','client','-addr','127.0.0.1:7000','-bytes',str(size),'-workers','16','-shards',str(shards),'-duration',str(duration)+'s','-budgets','off','-allocation-probe','-version','old-client-'+version+'-server']
  state_cmd=['docker','exec',name,'cat','/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat','/proc/loadavg','/proc/pressure/cpu']
  state_before=cmd(state_cmd).stdout.decode()
  started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
  proc=subprocess.Popen(client,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
  profiles={}
  if diagnostic:
   time.sleep(2)
   requests=[('cpu','profile?seconds=8'),('allocs','allocs'),('mutex','mutex'),('block','block')] if diagnostic=='cpu' else [('trace','trace?seconds=3')]
   for kind,path in requests:
    t=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    fetch=['docker','exec',name,'/bench/old-probe','-fetch','http://127.0.0.1:6060/debug/pprof/'+path]
    r=cmd(fetch,25);(E/(label+'.'+kind)).write_bytes(r.stdout)
    profiles[kind]={'started':t,'finished':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'bytes':len(r.stdout),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest(),'command':fetch}
  stdout,stderr=proc.communicate(timeout=duration+30);(E/(label+'.txt')).write_bytes(stdout+stderr);assert proc.returncode==0,(stdout,stderr)
  result=json.loads(stdout);assert result['errors']==0 and not result['sample_cap_hit'] and result['arch']=='arm64'
  assert len(result['worker_counts'])==16 and sum(result['worker_counts'])==result['calls'] and max(result['worker_counts'])<1000000
  assert result['shards']==shards
  assert result['server_allocation']['enabled'] and result['server_allocation']['bytes_per_call']>0
  assert result['elapsed_seconds']>=duration and result['request_budgets']==False
  peak=cmd(['docker','exec',name,'cat','/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak']).stdout.decode().strip()
  state_after=cmd(state_cmd).stdout.decode()
  row=dict(runtime_state_before=state_before,runtime_state_after=state_after,runtime_state_command=state_cmd,label=label,server=version,diagnostic=diagnostic,started=started,finished=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),server_command=server,client_command=client,result=result,server_cgroup_memory_peak=int(peak),profiles=profiles,output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(stdout+stderr).hexdigest())
 finally:
  if proc and proc.poll() is None:
   subprocess.run(['docker','stop','--time','5',name+'-client'],capture_output=True,timeout=15);proc.communicate(timeout=15)
  if created:
   cmd(['docker','stop','--time','5',name]);state=json.loads(cmd(['docker','inspect',name]).stdout)[0]['State'];assert not state['Running'] and state['ExitCode']==0,state
   (E/(label+'-server.txt')).write_bytes(cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout)
   cmd(['docker','rm',name]);(E/(label+'-cleanup.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'name':name,'state':state},indent=2))
 if row:
  rows.append(row);(E/output_file).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps({'label':label,'calls':result['calls'],'rpc_s':round(result['calls_per_second'],2),'p99_ms':result['p99_ms'],'profiles':list(profiles)}),flush=True)

import pathlib,subprocess,json,time,datetime,hashlib,itertools,sys
E=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rows=[]
def cmd(args,timeout=30,**kwargs):return subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=timeout,**kwargs)
def run(label,version,duration=10,diagnostic=None):
 name='wk-listener-'+label
 server=['docker','run','-d','--name',name,'--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--cpuset-cpus','4-7','--memory','3g','-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','-e','GOGC=100','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/'+version+'-probe','debian:12','-mode','server','-addr','127.0.0.1:7000','-read='+str(read).lower(),'-version',version]
 if diagnostic:server+=['-pprof','127.0.0.1:6060']
 created=False;proc=None;row=None
 try:
  cmd(server);created=True;deadline=time.monotonic()+15
  while True:
   logs=cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout
   if b'RPC_PROBE_READY' in logs:break
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline,logs
   time.sleep(.2)
  client=['docker','run','--rm','--name',name+'-client','--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--network','container:'+name,'--cpuset-cpus','0-3','--memory','3g','-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','-e','GOGC=100','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/'+client_binary,'debian:12','-mode','client','-addr','127.0.0.1:7000','-bytes',str(size),'-workers','16','-shards',str(shards),'-duration',str(duration)+'s','-budgets',budgets,'-version','fixed-'+client_binary+'-'+version+'-server']
  state_cmd=['docker','exec',name,'cat','/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat','/proc/loadavg','/proc/pressure/cpu']
  state_before=cmd(state_cmd).stdout.decode()
  started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
  proc=subprocess.Popen(client,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
  profiles={}
  if diagnostic:
   time.sleep(2)
   requests=[('cpu','profile?seconds=8'),('allocs','allocs'),('mutex','mutex'),('block','block')] if diagnostic=='cpu' else [('trace','trace?seconds=3')]
   for kind,path in requests:
    t=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    fetch=['docker','exec',name,'/bench/old-probe','-fetch','http://127.0.0.1:6060/debug/pprof/'+path]
    r=cmd(fetch,25);(E/(label+'.'+kind)).write_bytes(r.stdout)
    profiles[kind]={'started':t,'finished':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'bytes':len(r.stdout),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest(),'command':fetch}
  stdout,stderr=proc.communicate(timeout=duration+30);(E/(label+'.txt')).write_bytes(stdout+stderr);assert proc.returncode==0,(stdout,stderr)
  result=json.loads(stdout);assert result['errors']==0 and not result['sample_cap_hit'] and result['arch']=='arm64'

  assert result['shards']==shards
  assert result['elapsed_seconds']>=duration and result['request_budgets']==(budgets=='on')
  peak=cmd(['docker','exec',name,'cat','/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak']).stdout.decode().strip()
  state_after=cmd(state_cmd).stdout.decode()
  row=dict(runtime_state_before=state_before,runtime_state_after=state_after,runtime_state_command=state_cmd,label=label,server=version,diagnostic=diagnostic,started=started,finished=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),server_command=server,client_command=client,result=result,server_cgroup_memory_peak=int(peak),profiles=profiles,output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(stdout+stderr).hexdigest())
 finally:
  if proc and proc.poll() is None:

  if created:
   cmd(['docker','stop','--time','5',name]);state=json.loads(cmd(['docker','inspect',name]).stdout)[0]['State'];assert not state['Running'] and state['ExitCode']==0,state
   (E/(label+'-server.txt')).write_bytes(cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout)
   cmd(['docker','rm',name]);(E/(label+'-cleanup.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'name':name,'state':state},indent=2))
 if row:
  rows.append(row);(E/output_file).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps({'label':label,'calls':result['calls'],'rpc_s':round(result['calls_per_second'],2),'p99_ms':result['p99_ms'],'profiles':list(profiles)}),flush=True)

import pathlib,subprocess,json,time,datetime,hashlib,itertools,sys
E=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rows=[]
def cmd(args,timeout=30,**kwargs):return subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=timeout,**kwargs)
def run(label,version,duration=10,diagnostic=None):
 name='wk-listener-'+label
 server=['docker','run','-d','--name',name,'--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--cpuset-cpus','4-7','--memory','3g','-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','-e','GOGC=100','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/'+version+'-probe','debian:12','-mode','server','-addr','127.0.0.1:7000','-read='+str(read).lower(),'-version',version,'-allocation-probe']
 if diagnostic:server+=['-pprof','127.0.0.1:6060']
 created=False;proc=None;row=None
 try:
  cmd(server);created=True;deadline=time.monotonic()+15
  while True:
   logs=cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout
   if b'RPC_PROBE_READY' in logs:break
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline,logs
   time.sleep(.2)
  client=['docker','run','--rm','--name',name+'-client','--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--network','container:'+name,'--cpuset-cpus','0-3','--memory','3g','-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','-e','GOGC=100','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/old-alloc-probe','debian:12','-mode','client','-addr','127.0.0.1:7000','-bytes',str(size),'-workers','16','-shards',str(shards),'-duration',str(duration)+'s','-budgets','off','-allocation-probe','-version','old-client-'+version+'-server']
  state_cmd=['docker','exec',name,'cat','/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat','/proc/loadavg','/proc/pressure/cpu']
  state_before=cmd(state_cmd).stdout.decode()
  started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
  proc=subprocess.Popen(client,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
  profiles={}
  if diagnostic:
   time.sleep(2)
   requests=[('cpu','profile?seconds=8'),('allocs','allocs'),('mutex','mutex'),('block','block')] if diagnostic=='cpu' else [('trace','trace?seconds=3')]
   for kind,path in requests:
    t=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    fetch=['docker','exec',name,'/bench/old-probe','-fetch','http://127.0.0.1:6060/debug/pprof/'+path]
    r=cmd(fetch,25);(E/(label+'.'+kind)).write_bytes(r.stdout)
    profiles[kind]={'started':t,'finished':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'bytes':len(r.stdout),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest(),'command':fetch}
  stdout,stderr=proc.communicate(timeout=duration+30);(E/(label+'.txt')).write_bytes(stdout+stderr);assert proc.returncode==0,(stdout,stderr)
  result=json.loads(stdout);assert result['errors']==0 and not result['sample_cap_hit'] and result['arch']=='arm64'

rows=[]

def run(label,version,duration=10,diagnostic=None):
 name='wk-listener-'+label
 server=['docker','run','-d','--name',name,'--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--cpuset-cpus','4-7','--memory','3g','-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','-e','GOGC=100','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/'+version+'-probe','debian:12','-mode','server','-addr','127.0.0.1:7000','-read='+str(read).lower(),'-version',version]
 if diagnostic:server+=['-pprof','127.0.0.1:6060']
 created=False;proc=None;row=None
 try:
  cmd(server);created=True;deadline=time.monotonic()+15
  while True:
   logs=cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout
   if b'RPC_PROBE_READY' in logs:break
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline,logs
   time.sleep(.2)
  client=['docker','run','--rm','--name',name+'-client','--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--network','container:'+name,'--cpuset-cpus','0-3','--memory','3g','-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','-e','GOGC=100','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/old-probe','debian:12','-mode','client','-addr','127.0.0.1:7000','-bytes',str(size),'-workers','16','-shards',str(shards),'-duration',str(duration)+'s','-budgets','off','-version','old-client-'+version+'-server']
  state_cmd=['docker','exec',name,'cat','/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat','/proc/loadavg','/proc/pressure/cpu']
  state_before=cmd(state_cmd).stdout.decode()
  started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
  proc=subprocess.Popen(client,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
  profiles={}
  if diagnostic:
   time.sleep(2)
   requests=[('cpu','profile?seconds=8'),('allocs','allocs'),('mutex','mutex'),('block','block')] if diagnostic=='cpu' else [('trace','trace?seconds=3')]
   for kind,path in requests:
    t=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    fetch=['docker','exec',name,'/bench/old-probe','-fetch','http://127.0.0.1:6060/debug/pprof/'+path]
    r=cmd(fetch,25);(E/(label+'.'+kind)).write_bytes(r.stdout)
    profiles[kind]={'started':t,'finished':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'bytes':len(r.stdout),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest(),'command':fetch}
  stdout,stderr=proc.communicate(timeout=duration+30);(E/(label+'.txt')).write_bytes(stdout+stderr);assert proc.returncode==0,(stdout,stderr)
  result=json.loads(stdout);assert result['errors']==0 and not result['sample_cap_hit'] and result['arch']=='arm64'
  assert len(result['worker_counts'])==16 and sum(result['worker_counts'])==result['calls'] and max(result['worker_counts'])<1000000
  assert result['shards']==shards
  assert result['elapsed_seconds']>=duration and result['request_budgets']==False
  peak=cmd(['docker','exec',name,'cat','/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak']).stdout.decode().strip()
  state_after=cmd(state_cmd).stdout.decode()
  row=dict(runtime_state_before=state_before,runtime_state_after=state_after,runtime_state_command=state_cmd,label=label,server=version,diagnostic=diagnostic,started=started,finished=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),server_command=server,client_command=client,result=result,server_cgroup_memory_peak=int(peak),profiles=profiles,output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(stdout+stderr).hexdigest())
 finally:
  if proc and proc.poll() is None:
   subprocess.run(['docker','stop','--time','5',name+'-client'],capture_output=True,timeout=15);proc.communicate(timeout=15)
  if created:
   cmd(['docker','stop','--time','5',name]);state=json.loads(cmd(['docker','inspect',name]).stdout)[0]['State'];assert not state['Running'] and state['ExitCode']==0,state
   (E/(label+'-server.txt')).write_bytes(cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout)
   cmd(['docker','rm',name]);(E/(label+'-cleanup.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'name':name,'state':state},indent=2))
 if row:
  rows.append(row);(E/output_file).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps({'label':label,'calls':result['calls'],'rpc_s':round(result['calls_per_second'],2),'p99_ms':result['p99_ms'],'profiles':list(profiles)}),flush=True)

 created=False;proc=None;row=None
 try:

  state_cmd=['docker','exec',name,'cat','/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat','/proc/loadavg','/proc/pressure/cpu']
  state_before=cmd(state_cmd).stdout.decode()
  started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
  proc=subprocess.Popen(client,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
  profiles={}
  if diagnostic:
   time.sleep(2)
   requests=[('cpu','profile?seconds=8'),('allocs','allocs'),('mutex','mutex'),('block','block')] if diagnostic=='cpu' else [('trace','trace?seconds=3')]
   for kind,path in requests:
    t=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    fetch=['docker','exec',name,'/bench/old-probe','-fetch','http://127.0.0.1:6060/debug/pprof/'+path]

  row=dict(runtime_state_before=state_before,runtime_state_after=state_after,runtime_state_command=state_cmd,label=label,server=version,diagnostic=diagnostic,started=started,finished=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),server_command=server,client_command=client,result=result,server_cgroup_memory_peak=int(peak),profiles=profiles,output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(stdout+stderr).hexdigest())

  if created:

   (E/(label+'-server.txt')).write_bytes(cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout)
   cmd(['docker','rm',name]);(E/(label+'-cleanup.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'name':name,'state':state},indent=2))
 if row:
  rows.append(row);(E/output_file).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')

import pathlib,subprocess,json,time,datetime,hashlib,itertools,sys
E=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rows=[]
def cmd(args,timeout=30,**kwargs):return subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=timeout,**kwargs)
def run(label,version,duration=10,diagnostic=None):
 name='wk-listener-'+label
 server=['docker','run','-d','--name',name,'--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--cpuset-cpus','4-7','--memory','3g','-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','-e','GOGC=100','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/'+version+'-probe','debian:12','-mode','server','-reject','-addr','127.0.0.1:7000','-read='+str(read).lower(),'-version',version]
 if diagnostic:server+=['-pprof','127.0.0.1:6060']
 created=False;proc=None;row=None
 try:
  cmd(server);created=True;deadline=time.monotonic()+15
  while True:
   logs=cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout
   if b'RPC_PROBE_READY' in logs:break
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline,logs
   time.sleep(.2)
  client=['docker','run','--rm','--name',name+'-client','--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--network','container:'+name,'--cpuset-cpus','0-3','--memory','3g','-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','-e','GOGC=100','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/base-overload-probe','debian:12','-mode','client','-reject','-addr','127.0.0.1:7000','-bytes',str(size),'-workers','16','-shards',str(shards),'-duration',str(duration)+'s','-budgets','off','-version','old-client-'+version+'-server']
  state_cmd=['docker','exec',name,'cat','/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat','/proc/loadavg','/proc/pressure/cpu']
  state_before=cmd(state_cmd).stdout.decode()
  started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
  proc=subprocess.Popen(client,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
  profiles={}
  if diagnostic:
   time.sleep(2)
   requests=[('cpu','profile?seconds=8'),('allocs','allocs'),('mutex','mutex'),('block','block')] if diagnostic=='cpu' else [('trace','trace?seconds=3')]
   for kind,path in requests:
    t=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    fetch=['docker','exec',name,'/bench/old-probe','-fetch','http://127.0.0.1:6060/debug/pprof/'+path]
    r=cmd(fetch,25);(E/(label+'.'+kind)).write_bytes(r.stdout)
    profiles[kind]={'started':t,'finished':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'bytes':len(r.stdout),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest(),'command':fetch}
  stdout,stderr=proc.communicate(timeout=duration+30);(E/(label+'.txt')).write_bytes(stdout+stderr);assert proc.returncode==0,(stdout,stderr)
  result=json.loads(stdout);assert result['errors']==0 and not result['sample_cap_hit'] and result['arch']=='arm64'
  assert len(result['worker_counts'])==16 and sum(result['worker_counts'])==result['calls'] and max(result['worker_counts'])<1000000
  assert result['shards']==shards
  assert result['elapsed_seconds']>=duration and result['request_budgets']==False
  peak=cmd(['docker','exec',name,'cat','/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak']).stdout.decode().strip()
  state_after=cmd(state_cmd).stdout.decode()
  row=dict(runtime_state_before=state_before,runtime_state_after=state_after,runtime_state_command=state_cmd,label=label,server=version,diagnostic=diagnostic,started=started,finished=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),server_command=server,client_command=client,result=result,server_cgroup_memory_peak=int(peak),profiles=profiles,output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(stdout+stderr).hexdigest())
 finally:
  if proc and proc.poll() is None:
   subprocess.run(['docker','stop','--time','5',name+'-client'],capture_output=True,timeout=15);proc.communicate(timeout=15)
  if created:
   cmd(['docker','stop','--time','5',name]);state=json.loads(cmd(['docker','inspect',name]).stdout)[0]['State'];assert not state['Running'] and state['ExitCode']==0,state
   (E/(label+'-server.txt')).write_bytes(cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout)
   cmd(['docker','rm',name]);(E/(label+'-cleanup.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'name':name,'state':state},indent=2))
 if row:
  rows.append(row);(E/output_file).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps({'label':label,'calls':result['calls'],'rpc_s':round(result['calls_per_second'],2),'p99_ms':result['p99_ms'],'profiles':list(profiles)}),flush=True)

report-draft.md.text:
# RPC 无调用预算请求的队列取消监听实验

本轮验证复用连接内取消入口的候选：保留标准请求context和请求表，为没有调用方时间预算的请求
增加一个可撤销的队列取消回调。带预算请求及通用context仍走context.AfterFunc。
普通64B写RPC的服务端分配减少约304B、1次/RPC（约19.3%字节）。最终取舍见下方验收结果。

## 来源和约束

基线`edcf2b746022fcb40ac4adf5ac7a567ceb9e4041`，根AGENTS摘要已冻结，transport无适用FLOW。
复用上一轮当前版及固定旧客户端二进制；基线transport与依赖文件和其构建版本`e5fe7eb74`一致。
新增候选、分配及拒绝探针都保留源码、构建命令、源码/二进制SHA256。

预先提出：复用已有取消入口可降低通用监听分配；分配下降后必须继续检查实际吞吐；
若同步或执行开销占主导，跨拓扑的吞吐收益可能不足。所有预测通过真实进程窗口验证，
不把单个有利窗口或分配下降直接等同于解决原始版本回退。

Linux ARM64 Docker VM、Apple M4、Go1.25.11、GOMAXPROCS=4、GOGC=100。
静态ARM64程序使用已有Debian amd64 rootfs，进程输出确认arm64。
客户端CPU0–3、服务端CPU4–7，各3GiB内存，独立进程使用同一网络命名空间loopback。
固定16调用者、PoolSize16、活动连接1/16、服务并发64、队列4096项/64MiB、排队5s、执行30s、
调用方2s。普通写不取消已执行的mutation，读控制设置CancelRunning=true。
纯计时每窗10s，样本上限每调用者100万，校验全部回显字节；没有profile或分配HTTP采集。

主批每拓扑4对AB/BA及基线/候选各1对A/A。单连接出现反向配对后，再以相反起始顺序
补4对及两版A/A，不删除首批或复测的不利样本。控制组各两对交换顺序。
这些结果只适用于本机负载，不能替代原生x86跨主机或完整集群容量验收。

## 机制和并发边界

原路径context.AfterFunc为排队取消注册通用子context。候选的inboundQueueContext保留底层
标准context，额外保存单个队列回调；它不改变Deadline、Done、Err、Value及context.Cause。
CancelInbound、请求Finish、连接关闭的请求表遍历均调用同一个取消入口。
连接Close先取消父context，再遍历请求表；监听注册检查当前Err，覆盖两步间的竞争。

回调注册/撤销/取消由对象互斥锁仲裁，回调在锁外异步执行；撤销失败不等待已启动回调。
同一对象的额外监听回退标准context.AfterFunc，不覆盖首个队列所有者。
对象不池化，保留已启动过期回调需要的引用；Service.mu继续决定出队、超时及停止谁取得终结权。
没有绕过FIFO、截止时间、共享执行器、准入或保留内存上限，也没有改变已运行写请求的取消策略。

候选会在准入前增加一个对象和取消方法值，因此失败准入可能增加分配。该代价通过独立
全拒绝负载测量，未仅测成功路径。

## 普通64B写请求

|批次/连接|基线RPC/s中位|候选RPC/s中位|吞吐变化|基线P99 ms|候选P99 ms|P99变化|
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|首批/1|171,692.11|180,967.13|+5.40%|0.612271|0.335896|−45.14%|
|首批/16|212,005.61|224,068.41|+5.69%|0.385438|0.221875|−42.44%|
|单连接复测|170,503.23|180,963.89|+6.14%|0.608542|0.295875|−51.38%|

首批1连接配对吞吐：+7.38%、+4.51%、−2.09%、+4.82%；16连接：+8.79%、+2.00%、+3.47%、+7.09%。
单连接复测：−6.15%、+6.07%、+5.85%、+6.20%。十二对P99均下降，但最小改善只有1.81%。
单连接八对有两对吞吐下降，不能声称每次运行都改善或已经稳定恢复原始吞吐。

首批A/A吞吐：1连接基线+0.10%、候选−3.80%；16连接基线−3.43%、候选+0.77%。
复测1连接基线+0.65%、候选−2.39%。候选单连接A/A的P99变化达+51.98%和+45.16%，
尾延迟本身也有噪声；保留全部结果，未将少量A/A当作严格置信区间。

按每窗cgroup CPU增量/成功调用数估算的服务端成本中位，首批1连接下降3.05%、16连接下降4.44%，
单连接复测下降3.76%。观测区间包含预热、少量采集及后台工作，不是精确handler CPU时间。
保存CPU quota计数、loadavg和pressure，未据此宣称宿主环境无干扰。

## 分配诊断

两轮、两种拓扑共8窗，每窗5s，固定旧版分配诊断客户端。预热后通过loopback端点让服务端GC，
读取MemStats，完成工作后再次读取，以增量/成功调用数估算B/RPC及分配次数。
